## tfskel scaffold workflows

Generate per-environment GitHub Actions workflow files

### Synopsis

Generates per-environment GitHub Actions workflow files from templates.

This command creates:
  - .github/workflows/<env>-terraform-plan-apply.yaml

Use 'tfskel init' to generate shared reusable workflow files (lint.yaml,
reusable-detect-changes.yaml, reusable-terraform-plan-apply.yaml, reusable-lint.yaml).

Configuration:
  Reads .tfskel.yaml from the current directory. Workflow generation can be
  disabled entirely with 'workflows.create: false' in the config file.

```
tfskel scaffold workflows [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Generate workflow for dev environment
  tfskel scaffold workflows --env dev

  # Generate workflow with custom config
  tfskel scaffold workflows --env prd --config ./my-config.yaml
```

### Options

```
  -e, --env string   target environment (e.g., dev, stg, prd) - required
      --force        with --upgrade, overwrite files even without source markers
  -h, --help         help for workflows
      --upgrade      re-render workflow files from updated templates
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -c, --config string   config file (default is .tfskel.yaml in current directory)
      --dry-run         show what would happen without writing files
      --no-color        disable colored output (respects NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR env vars)
  -v, --verbose         enable verbose output
```
